name: Door Prep (Inspect, Sand, Fill)
intent: Inspect each door side, light sand for adhesion, fill any fastener marks or defects, sand the fill smooth, seal MDF edges (not for solid wood or louvered), wipe dust before primer/finish. Per-door-side rates because each side of each door is independent work.
doctrine: Sand prep is the slowest task (8 sides/hr = 7.5 minutes per side) because it covers the full door surface. Fill, sand fill, and clean dust are spot tasks at 30 sides/hr (2 minutes each). MDF edge seal only fires for flush, panel_4, panel_6 door types — louvered doors have too many slats for edge sealing to be practical and french doors have glass-panel construction with minimal MDF edge exposure.
